text:
GT World Series 2026 | Round 2 - Tokyo | Nations Cup | [English]
The GT World Series visits several locations across the globe on the way to the World Finals. Round 2 closes out the first half of the season with a battle in Tokyo, Japan.

Round 1 in Milan again saw the Spanish Armada dominate the field. Along with Jose Serrano and Pol Urra, the promising rookie Samuel Moreno Baeza, a newcomer for 2026, also showed incredible skills.

Will the Spanish drivers be able to do it again and beat out the competition for a full podium finish? Will the rivals get their revenge and put themselves one step ahead for the latter half of the season? This critical round will set the course of the rest of the season, so make sure you don’t miss it.

For more details regarding the 'Gran Turismo World Series' 2026, please visit the official website at: https://www.gran-turismo.com/us/gt7/events/gtws2026/tokyo/

author: PlayStation YouTube
text:
GT World Series 2026 | Round 2 - Tokyo | Manufacturers Cup | [English]
The critical midpoint of the 2026 Series is held at the Polyphony Digital studio in Tokyo.

The Manufacturers Cup is contested by 12 manufacturer teams made up of our Official Sponsors Toyota and Mazda, as well as the top teams from the Online Qualifiers. Held at the Tokyo Studio in a first for an official series round, the Asia-Oceania drivers will be taking the wheel for their teams.

All eyes are on Ferrari who put up an extremely impressive battle against last year’s champions Porsche in the opening round. With updated machines on the field, there is every possibility this season may see the status quo be completely rewritten. We hope you’ll join us for this mid-Summer race to top off the first half of the season.

For more details regarding the 'Gran Turismo World Series' 2026, please visit the official website at: https://www.gran-turismo.com/us/gt7/events/gtws2026/tokyo/
